name: loop-plan
description: First half of the SD Loop with a human checkpoint: RESEARCH → PLAN, then STOP for human review of loop-docs/research.md, loop-docs/architecture.md and goal.md. No deliverable code is written. After review, continue in the same workspace with `sdharness run <workspace> --method loop --in-place --skip-completed-phases` — the existing artifacts satisfy the RESEARCH/PLAN gates, so it starts directly in BUILD.

phase_prompts.RESEARCH:
You are in the RESEARCH phase of the SD Loop. Produce `loop-docs/research.md` BEFORE any planning or code.

This is NOT a human interview — the intake `vision.md` / `tech-env.md` at the workspace ROOT is what you were handed; verify it is SUFFICIENT (the goal, hard constraints, and success criteria are present and unambiguous) and resolve the technical unknowns the work depends on.

1. Intake sufficiency — confirm goal + constraints + success criteria are clear. Runs are autonomous: if something load-bearing is missing, DO NOT block — record the assumption you are proceeding on under a `## Decisions` section.
2. Resolve unknowns — research the specifics the plan will hinge on using your tools and the existing files.
3. Write `loop-docs/research.md`: intake-sufficiency summary, key technical findings (with sources), open assumptions (Decisions), and risks the plan must address. Leave NO `- [ ]` in it when the phase is done.

Keep it proportional. Do NOT scaffold or write application code yet. Do NOT write architecture.md or goal.md yet.

If the workspace already contains a codebase (brownfield), survey the existing implementation relevant to the intake FIRST — read the code, cite file paths, and record what is wrong with it today and why — before researching alternatives.
phase_prompts.PLAN:
You are in the PLAN phase. Produce `loop-docs/architecture.md` and the milestone contract `goal.md` (at the workspace ROOT), grounded in `loop-docs/research.md`.

Use a propose → critique → reconcile dialectic — do not free-associate one draft:
- Propose an architecture: enumerate every component and the wiring/dependency topology (which component interacts with which).
- Critique it: where can it silently half-work? (a declared component nothing invokes; a boundary assumed wrong; a seam with no test).
- Reconcile: fold the critique in until the design is internally consistent.

`architecture.md` MUST contain: (1) a component list, (2) an explicit wiring/dependency topology naming every cross-component interaction, and (3) an integration-test list — the concrete end-to-end seams to prove in VERIFY. Every declared component must appear in at least one integration test.

**If this is a UI / frontend build** (a design skill like `frontend-design` is attached, or the intake asks for a visual interface), also settle the visual system NOW and write it to `loop-docs/design.md` — a STRUCTURED design-token doc, not a vague paragraph. Use the attached design skill to commit to ONE bold, cohesive aesthetic, then capture it as named token groups (palette / typography + type scale / spacing / radius / elevation / motion / component patterns) plus a short **Do's & Don'ts**. This file is the run's cross-turn consistency anchor: BUILD conforms EVERY section to it, so the last section is as polished and on-brand as the first (without it, the design drifts across turns). Non-UI builds (CLI, API, data pipeline) skip this — there is no design.md.

Then write `goal.md` at the workspace ROOT (the milestone contract the BUILD phase drives) so its milestones implement this architecture — the FIRST milestone scaffolds the project at the workspace ROOT. Leave NO `- [ ]` in architecture.md; goal.md's milestones stay `- [ ]` (BUILD checks them off). Do NOT write application code yet.

This is a PLAN-ONLY run: it stops when PLAN is done and a human reviews research.md, architecture.md and goal.md before any BUILD. Write anything the reviewer must decide under a `## Questions for reviewer` section in architecture.md as plain bullets (NOT `- [ ]` checkboxes — those block the phase gate). Give each option its trade-off and your recommendation.

rules.hint: PLAN-ONLY run: no deliverable code. Only harness artifacts (loop-docs/**, goal.md, the intake, the agent-context seed) may be written. BUILD happens in a separate `--method loop` run after human review.
